# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture on an Apple M4 (macOS 27.0.1): the first computed level
# of RGB10A2Unorm and BGR10A2Unorm textures whose first levels were designed, footprint by
# footprint, so that the 2-bit alpha's weighted sums fall near the halves of its grid (WP-FXR's
# EV FXR-fxr9-m4, our own probe; DESIGN D715). Every texel of those levels where the 2-bit code of
# the 12-bit grid of 2-bit codes and the nearest 2-bit code of the 10-bit code the codes replicate
# to differ: 2,354 of the 475,136 values measured, each the 10-bit code's (the rest agree on
# both). The 1,293 of a 1025x1025 texture are left out here; the chains below hold the other 1,061.
# Format:
#   chain <format> <width>x<height>
#   <x> <y> <the alpha codes of the texel's taps: x0y0 x1y0 x0y1 x1y1> <the code Metal stored>
